question: Given $A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$ and $P = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$, compute $P^{-1} A P$.
explanation:
First, $|P| = 1 \cdot 0 - (-1) \cdot 1 = 1$. Thus, $P^{-1} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$.

Compute $AP$:

$A P = \begin{bmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 1 & 1\end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 2 & -1 \end{bmatrix}$

$P^{-1} A P = P^{-1}(A P)$

Multiply:

Row 1: $0 \cdot 2 + 1 \cdot 2 = 2$, $0 \cdot 0 + 1 \cdot (-1) = -1$.

Row 2: $-1\cdot 2 + 1\cdot 2 = 0$, $-1\cdot 0 + 1\cdot(-1)= -1$.

So $P^{-1}AP = \begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\0&-1\end{bmatrix}$.
